payload.abstract: The database contains acceleration signals from accelerometers attached directly on the epicardium in canines and porcines during various interventions that altered cardiac function and myocardial motion. The tri-axial accelerometer was attached in the anterior, apical region of the left ventricle (LV). The database contains a total of 289 recordings from 19 canines and 27 porcines with an average duration of 15 seconds, ranging from 5 to 30 seconds. Acceleration data was recorded simultaneously with ECG and LV pressure (LVP).

payload.short_description: The dataset contains data recorded from epicardially attached accelerometer to canines' and porcines' hearts. The data comprises of tri-axial acceleration signals, left ventricular pressure (LVP), rate of change of LVP and in some cases ECG as well.
payload.title: Epicardially attached cardiac accelerometer data from canines and porcines
